page.layout: Two printed pages, left and right, each one column of running text with verse; the right page is cut at its right edge. Running head at top of the left page is "THEOD. BEZÆ"; no page number printed. Left page: a title heading, then verse, a rule, a second heading and verse. Right page: the continuation of the verse lines, cut off at the scan edge.

main_text.l: Qui nunc Æmylia correptus amore Venusta,
Ne tamen, Aonides, Sestrum sic esse Melissum
Æmyliam potius sic Vobis addidit ille:
Tot pariet Satos quot erit paritura Melisos:
Tot pariet Musas quot erit paritura Melissas: Queis ἀμυλλότερον nihil.
Hoc sperare iubet, certo Velut omine, nomen
Et ille ἐς ista quod gerit.
At tu, qua charo gratus Beza optat amico,
OMine quam fausto Aemyliam Venus alma
Iunxerit, en felix exitus ipse probat.
Hos etenim sanctę per mutua gaudia iunctos

page.notes: The right page is cut off at the scan edge; its text is partly lost. Several Greek words and the initial letters of the verses are unclear and may be misread. Long s has been rendered as s; the verse breaks follow the printed lines.
